dossier.headline: Gulf attacks keep oil on edge as supply-glut worries pull prices lower
dossier.summary: Tankers were hit near the Strait of Hormuz over the 22 Nov weekend and Iran attacked US positions in Bahrain, yet Brent kept falling on expectations of a supply surplus. On 25 Nov Brent fell 1.4% to $87.54 early, helping India's rally, before climbing off its lows after the Houthis confirmed strikes on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery and Iran stepped up its Hormuz rhetoric.
why_it_matters: Lower crude was cited as a driver of India's 25 Nov rally and of the FMCG surge
Attacks on Gulf oil facilities and shipping could reverse the slide quickly
